events.title: UK offshore support office opens in Warrington
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind opened a Warrington office supporting construction, servicing, health and safety, and quality assurance for its UK offshore projects.

events.title: Taiwan offshore supply-chain agreements
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed four memoranda with Taiwanese companies covering towers, blade manufacturing and blade materials.

events.title: SMART offshore turbine tools launched
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind launched a digital tool suite for offshore turbine design assessment, monitoring and operational decisions, including integrated foundation-load software developed with Ramboll.

events.title: Parkwind selects turbines for Northwester 2
events.summary: Parkwind selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply 23 V164-9.5 MW turbines for Northwester 2 in Belgium.

events.title: Taiwan generator supply memorandum signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a memorandum with TECO and The Switch for generator products for the Taiwanese offshore market.

events.title: Blyth demonstration turbines commissioned
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind commissioned five V164-8.4 MW turbines at the Blyth Offshore Wind Demonstration Project.

events.title: V164-9.5 MW receives final type certification
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind announced Class S type certification for the V164-9.5 MW offshore turbine.

events.title: Borssele III and IV reach financial close
events.summary: The Blauwwind consortium reached financial close on Borssele III and IV, advancing plans to use 77 V164-9.5 MW turbines made by MHI Vestas Offshore Wind.

events.title: Deutsche Bucht mono-bucket demonstration advances
events.summary: The Deutsche Bucht demonstration reached financial close for a planned trial of two MHI Vestas Offshore Wind V164-8.4 MW turbines on mono-bucket foundations.

events.title: Conditional turbine agreement signed for Moray East
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional supply agreement for the 950 MW Moray East offshore wind project in the UK.

events.title: Last Borkum Riffgrund 2 turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind completed installation of all 56 turbines at Borkum Riffgrund 2 in its first German offshore wind project.

events.title: Triton Knoll turbine order confirmed
events.summary: The Triton Knoll firm order covered 90 V164-9.5 MW turbines from MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and five years of service and maintenance.

events.title: Walney Extension opens
events.summary: The Walney Extension was inaugurated with 40 V164-8.25 MW turbines supplied by MHI Vestas Offshore Wind alongside turbines from another supplier.

events.title: Aberdeen Bay offshore demonstration centre opens
events.summary: Vattenfall opened its European Offshore Wind Deployment Centre at Aberdeen Bay, where the eleven turbines included two MHI Vestas Offshore Wind V164-8.8 MW units.

events.title: WindPlus chooses MHI Vestas for WindFloat Atlantic
events.summary: WindPlus selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind for WindFloat Atlantic, a three-turbine floating offshore wind project in Portugal.

events.title: Testing relocates to free offshore blade-factory space
events.summary: Vestas agreed to relocate testing on the Isle of Wight so MHI Vestas Offshore Wind could consider expanding offshore blade production at West Medina Mills.

events.title: V164-10.0 MW offshore turbine launched
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind introduced the 10 MW version of its V164 offshore turbine platform.

events.title: Conditional Taiwan tower supply contract signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional contract with CS Wind and Chin Fong to manufacture offshore turbine towers locally.

events.title: Northwester 2 order becomes firm
events.summary: Belgian developer Parkwind and MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed the firm Northwester 2 order for 23 V164-9.5 MW turbines.

events.title: Second blade mould arrives on the Isle of Wight
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind received a new blade mould at its Isle of Wight factory as part of a plan to expand V164 blade manufacturing.

events.title: First Kincardine floating turbine installed
events.summary: Bourbon reported installation of the first floating turbine at Kincardine in summer 2018. The existing Projects record identifies this unit as a Vestas V80-2.0 MW.

events.title: Lindø nacelle plant plans capacity increase
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind announced additional hiring and revised testing at its Lindø nacelle factory to increase offshore production.

events.title: Vineyard Wind originally names MHI Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Vineyard Wind selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred turbine supplier for its 800 MW Massachusetts project. The developer later selected another supplier.

events.title: Rampion commissioning completed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that all 116 V112-3.45 MW turbines at the 400 MW Rampion wind farm had been installed and commissioned.

events.title: Moray East order confirmed
events.summary: Moray East placed a firm order with MHI Vestas Offshore Wind for 100 V164-9.5 MW turbines for its Scottish offshore wind farm.

events.title: Borssele V innovation site places turbine order
events.summary: Two Towers placed a firm order with MHI Vestas Offshore Wind for two V164-9.5 MW turbines for the Borssele V offshore innovation site.

events.title: Boston chosen as US offshore headquarters
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind selected Boston for its US headquarters to support offshore sales, strategy and a local project presence.

events.title: Offshore service base expands at Oostende
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind opened a larger base at the Port of Oostende to support its growing Belgian offshore maintenance portfolio.

events.title: Horns Reef 3 turbine installation completed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported the final turbine installation at Denmark’s Horns Reef 3 offshore wind farm.

events.title: First Norther turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed the first turbine at the Norther offshore wind farm in Belgium.

events.title: Baltic Eagle names preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Iberdrola named MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred turbine supplier for Baltic Eagle, with the V174-9.5 MW turbine specified.

events.title: Kincardine orders five floating wind turbines
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a firm order to supply five V164-9.5 MW turbines for the Kincardine floating offshore wind farm in Scotland.

events.title: Norther turbine installation completed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed completion of the turbine installation campaign at Norther in Belgium.

events.title: Borkum Riffgrund 2 turbines handed over
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and Ørsted marked the handover of the 56 Borkum Riffgrund 2 turbines for commercial operation.

events.title: First Deutsche Bucht turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed its first installation at the Deutsche Bucht offshore wind farm.

events.title: US offshore office opens in Boston
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind opened its Boston office for US offshore wind projects, sales and market strategy.

events.title: Taiwan offshore blade-materials contract signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional agreement with Swancor to source offshore blade materials in Taiwan.

events.title: Deutsche Bucht reaches first power
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that Deutsche Bucht began feeding electricity to the German grid.

events.title: First Taiwan switchgear localisation contract signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional agreement with Mitsubishi Electric Europe covering local high-voltage switchgear assembly by Shihlin Electric in Taiwan.

events.title: Horns Reef 3 officially opens
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported the inauguration of Horns Reef 3 offshore wind farm after the turbine installation and commissioning campaign.

events.title: Base turbine installation complete at Deutsche Bucht
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported installation of all 31 turbines in the main Deutsche Bucht project. The separate mono-bucket demonstration was a different scope.

events.title: Groix and Belle-Île chooses preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: The Groix and Belle-Île floating wind project selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred supplier for V164-9.5 MW turbines.

events.title: First WindFloat Atlantic turbine reaches its position
events.summary: The first MHI Vestas Offshore Wind turbine was moved into position at WindFloat Atlantic, using a floating platform assembled with the turbine in port.

events.title: EFGL selects V164-10.0 MW turbines
events.summary: The EFGL floating wind project selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply its V164-10.0 MW turbines.

events.title: Hibiki Wind Energy chooses preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Hibiki Wind Energy selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred supplier for the commercial Kitakyushu-Hibikinada offshore wind project in Japan.

events.title: Parkwind selects MHI Vestas for Arcadis Ost 1
events.summary: Parkwind selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply V174-9.5 MW offshore turbines for Germany’s Arcadis Ost 1 project.

events.title: First V164-9.5 MW installed at Northwester 2
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed its first V164-9.5 MW turbine at the Belgian Northwester 2 offshore wind farm.

events.title: Digital safety training introduced for offshore technicians
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind announced an app for safety refresher training for offshore wind turbine technicians.

events.title: WindFloat Atlantic delivers first electricity
events.summary: EDP Renewables announced that the first WindFloat Atlantic platform was supplying the Portuguese grid after connection on 31 December 2019. The unit carried an 8.4 MW MHI Vestas Offshore Wind turbine.

events.title: Rønne selected for Arcadis Ost 1 turbine pre-assembly
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind selected the Port of Rønne on Bornholm for pre-assembly and shipment of Arcadis Ost 1 turbine components.

events.title: V174-9.5 MW prototype installed at Østerild
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed its V174-9.5 MW offshore prototype at the Danish national test centre in Østerild.

events.title: Zhong Neng chooses preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported its selection as preferred supplier for Taiwan’s Zhong Neng offshore wind development.

events.title: Changfang and Xidao offshore orders confirmed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind finalised firm turbine-supply contracts with Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners for the Changfang and Xidao offshore wind farms in Taiwan.

events.title: Akita and Noshiro place a firm offshore turbine order
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind received a firm order for 33 V117-4.2 MW turbines across the fixed-bottom Akita and Noshiro projects in Japan.

events.title: Tien Li signs Taiwan blade manufacturing contract
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and Tien Li finalised a conditional agreement for local offshore blade manufacturing at a new facility planned for Taichung Harbour.

events.title: Northwester 2 turbine installation complete
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported installation of all 23 V164-9.5 MW turbines at Northwester 2.

events.title: Swancor offshore blade-materials agreement confirmed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed a purchase agreement with Swancor for locally sourced blade materials, including carbon plates, resin and adhesive.

events.title: First Borssele III and IV turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed the first of 77 V164-9.5 MW turbines for the Blauwwind Borssele III and IV project.

events.title: Final WindFloat Atlantic turbine departs for site
events.summary: The last of three floating units carrying MHI Vestas Offshore Wind V164-8.4 MW turbines left Ferrol for the WindFloat Atlantic site.

events.title: Conditional offshore turbine agreement signed for Seagreen
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional turbine supply agreement for the 1,140 MW Seagreen project. The firm order was confirmed separately.

events.title: Seagreen places firm offshore turbine order
events.summary: Seagreen finalised a firm order with MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply 114 offshore wind turbines for the Scottish project.

events.title: Construction starts at Taichung blade factory
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that its supplier Tien Li began construction of the Taichung Harbour facility for manufacturing offshore turbine blades.

events.title: Taiwan high-voltage switchgear purchase agreement
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind concluded a contract to source high-voltage switchgear locally for offshore turbines in Taiwan.

events.title: Local component sourcing expanded in Taiwan
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind agreed to buy rotor hubs, hub plates and nacelle base frames from Taiwan-based Yeong Guan Energy Technology Group.

events.title: Taiwan cables and fasteners sourced locally
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed agreements with Taiwanese suppliers for cables and fasteners for offshore wind projects.

events.title: WindFloat Atlantic reaches full power
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that all three floating turbines at WindFloat Atlantic were generating power.

events.title: Borssele III and IV deliver first power
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that the Borssele III and IV offshore wind farm began feeding power to the Dutch grid.

events.title: Taiwan tower purchase agreement finalised
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind finalised its Taiwan turbine tower purchase agreement with the CS Wind and Chin Fong partnership.

events.title: Additional turbine components to be sourced in Taiwan
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind agreed to buy spinner and nacelle covers from the Fassmer Atech Composites Taiwan joint venture.

events.title: Taiwan offshore transformer sourcing agreement
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a purchase agreement to source offshore turbine transformers locally in Taiwan.

events.title: EolMed chooses MHI Vestas as preferred supplier
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind was selected as preferred turbine supplier for the EolMed floating offshore wind farm in France.

events.title: Triton Knoll pre-assembly begins at Able Seaton Port
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind moved into Able Seaton Port to begin preparatory works for the Triton Knoll turbine installation campaign.

events.title: Agreement signed for Vestas to acquire offshore joint-venture stake
events.summary: Vestas and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries signed an agreement for Vestas to acquire MHI’s stake in MHI Vestas Offshore Wind. Completion still required approval.

events.title: First V164-9.5 MW fitted to a Kincardine floater
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind mounted the first of five Kincardine V164-9.5 MW turbines on a Principle Power WindFloat foundation at the installation harbour.

events.title: Borssele III and IV complete turbine installation
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported installation of the last of 77 V164-9.5 MW turbines for Borssele III and IV.

events.title: Competition authorities approve offshore joint-venture acquisition
events.summary: Vestas announced that competition authorities had approved its proposed acquisition of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ share of MHI Vestas Offshore Wind.

events.title: Vineyard Wind replaces preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Vineyard Wind named GE as preferred turbine supplier for Vineyard Wind 1, superseding the project’s earlier selection of MHI Vestas Offshore Wind.

events.title: Waterside Taichung turbine facility secured
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and the Changfang and Xidao project leased a waterside manufacturing site at Taichung for offshore turbine work.

events.title: Lindø makes its 500th V164 nacelle
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind produced its 500th V164 nacelle at its Lindø manufacturing site in Denmark.

events.title: Vestas completes acquisition of MHI’s offshore joint-venture stake
events.summary: Vestas acquired Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ stake in MHI Vestas Offshore Wind, taking full ownership of the former offshore joint venture. The parties expected organisational integration by 1 February 2021.

events.title: Offshore unit integrated into Vestas operating model
events.summary: Vestas announced the integration of former offshore joint-venture functions into its own organisation following the December 2020 acquisition.

events.title: New Japanese sales joint venture begins operations
events.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Vestas started operating MHI Vestas Japan, a separate venture to market onshore and offshore turbines in Japan.

events.title: V236-15.0 MW offshore platform unveiled
events.summary: Vestas introduced the V236-15.0 MW offshore turbine platform as it integrated its former offshore joint venture.

events.title: Arcadis Ost 1 places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured a firm Parkwind order for 27 V174-9.5 MW turbines at Arcadis Ost 1, a fixed-bottom project using an installation method from a floating vessel.

events.title: Iberdrola and Vestas finalise Baltic Eagle contract
events.summary: Vestas and Iberdrola finalised the Baltic Eagle contract, covering supply and installation of V174-9.5 MW turbines and long-term servicing.

events.title: EnBW preselects Vestas for He Dreiht
events.summary: EnBW preselected Vestas and its V236-15.0 MW turbine for He Dreiht, conditional on a firm order.

events.title: Triton Knoll completes turbine installation
events.summary: RWE announced the installation of the last of 90 Vestas V164-9.5 MW turbines at Triton Knoll.

events.title: Kincardine completes floating turbine installation
events.summary: Offtake partner Statkraft confirmed completion of turbine installation at Kincardine. The Vestas-equipped project has five V164 turbines and one smaller V80 unit.

events.title: Østerild selected for V236 prototype test
events.summary: Vestas selected Østerild in Denmark for the prototype and its initial power testing campaign.

events.title: Vestas named preferred supplier for both Empire Wind phases
events.summary: Empire Offshore Wind selected Vestas as preferred turbine supplier for Empire Wind 1 and 2, with a combined 2.1 GW of capacity announced at the time.

events.title: Asian business regions consolidated during offshore expansion
events.summary: Vestas announced the consolidation of its China and Asia-Pacific operations into a single region as part of its offshore expansion and wider organisational alignment.

events.title: TetraSpar floating demonstrator commissioned
events.summary: The TetraSpar partners commissioned the full-scale floating demonstrator off Norway using a 3.6 MW offshore wind turbine from Vestas.

events.title: All Triton Knoll turbines commissioned
events.summary: RWE announced completion of commissioning for the Vestas-equipped Triton Knoll offshore wind farm, with full operations still expected later in the quarter.

events.title: Ocean Winds places firm EFGL order
events.summary: Vestas secured an order from Ocean Winds for three V164-10.0 MW turbines for the 30 MW EFGL floating offshore wind project.

events.title: Separate 295 MW Taiwan order announced for Taipower Phase II
events.summary: Vestas secured a 295 MW offshore order from Foxwell Energy for Taiwan Power Company’s Phase II project, distinct from the Zhong Neng order announced the same day.

events.title: Zhong Neng places firm offshore order
events.summary: Vestas won a 295 MW turbine order for the Zhong Neng offshore wind project in Taiwan.

events.title: EnBW and Vestas sign conditional He Dreiht order
events.summary: Vestas and EnBW signed a conditional turbine supply and service agreement for the He Dreiht offshore project.

events.title: Vestas confirms EolMed turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured a 30 MW order to supply three V164-10.0 MW turbines for the EolMed floating offshore wind project in France.

events.title: Hydrogen-capable service vessel pilot announced
events.summary: Vestas and Windcat Workboats launched a pilot to test a dual-fuel hydrogen and marine-gas-oil crew transfer vessel at Norther.

events.title: Baltic Power names Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Baltic Power selected Vestas as preferred turbine supplier for its Polish offshore wind project, proposing V236-15.0 MW turbines.

events.title: Inch Cape chooses Vestas as preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Inch Cape Offshore selected Vestas as preferred supplier for its Scottish project, proposing the V236-15.0 MW turbine.

events.title: Atlantic Shores selects preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Atlantic Shores selected Vestas as preferred supplier for its 1.5 GW New Jersey offshore project. The release also described a proposed New Jersey nacelle assembly facility.

sources.publisher: Vestas and Atlantic Shores Offshore Wind

events.title: V236 nacelle and hub assembly plant announced in Poland
events.summary: Vestas announced plans to assemble V236-15.0 MW offshore nacelles and hubs at a new Szczecin facility.

events.title: Groix and Belle-Île floating wind project abandoned
events.summary: The developer abandoned the Groix and Belle-Île floating project in France. MHI Vestas Offshore Wind had previously been named preferred turbine supplier.

events.title: First Arcadis Ost 1 turbine installed from a floating vessel
events.summary: Heerema, Parkwind and Vestas installed the first V174-9.5 MW unit at the fixed-bottom Arcadis Ost 1 project using a floating-vessel rotor–nacelle assembly method.

events.title: MunmuBaram names Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: MunmuBaram selected Vestas as preferred turbine supplier for the 1.3 GW MunmuBaram floating project in South Korea. Supply of V236-15.0 MW turbines remained subject to further development.

events.title: Noshiro starts commercial operation after turbine installation
events.summary: Project partner Marubeni reported that Noshiro began commercial generation after all 33 turbines across Akita and Noshiro had been installed. The Vestas turbine package was documented in the earlier firm order.

events.title: V236 offshore prototype makes its first electricity
events.summary: Vestas announced that its V236-15.0 MW prototype generated its first power at Østerild in Denmark.

events.title: Nordseecluster names Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Vestas was named preferred supplier for up to 104 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the two-phase German Nordseecluster, subject to investment decisions.

events.title: Wando Geumil names Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Vestas signed a preferred supplier agreement with Korea South-East Power for the 600 MW Wando Geumil offshore project.

events.title: Preferred supplier agreement signed for 495 MW Korean floating project
events.summary: Vestas announced a preferred supplier agreement for an unnamed 495 MW South Korean floating offshore wind project using V236-15.0 MW turbines, conditional on the project proceeding.

events.title: Kitakyushu-Hibikinada places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas received a 238 MW order to supply and install 25 V174-9.5 MW turbines and provide long-term service for Japan’s commercial Kitakyushu-Hibikinada offshore project.

events.title: Final Seagreen turbine installed
events.summary: SSE reported that the last of 114 Vestas V164-10.0 MW turbines had been installed at Seagreen, with commissioning still in progress.

events.title: Conditional Baltic Power turbine agreement signed
events.summary: Vestas entered a conditional turbine supply agreement for Poland’s Baltic Power project before the subsequent firm order.

events.title: Baltic Power places firm order for 76 V236 turbines
events.summary: Vestas secured an order for 76 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the 1,140 MW Baltic Power offshore wind project in Poland.

events.title: He Dreiht places firm order for 64 V236 turbines
events.summary: Vestas secured a 960 MW order for 64 V236-15.0 MW turbines for EnBW’s He Dreiht project, with an initial five-year service agreement.

events.title: Seagreen reaches full operation
events.summary: SSE and TotalEnergies announced full operation of all 114 Vestas V164-10.0 MW turbines at Seagreen.

events.title: Arcadis Ost 1 completes turbine installation
events.summary: Parkwind, Heerema and Vestas installed the last three of 27 turbines at Arcadis Ost 1 using a floating installation method for the fixed-bottom project.

events.title: V236 receives DNV type certification
events.summary: DNV type-certified the Vestas V236-15.0 MW offshore platform following prototype testing at Østerild. Vestas’s annual report dates the certification to November 2023.

events.title: Vanguard West preferred supplier and neighbouring exclusivity agreements
events.summary: Vattenfall and Vestas agreed preferred supplier terms for Vanguard West and exclusivity terms for Vanguard East and Norfolk Boreas.

events.title: Ecowende places firm order for offshore turbines
events.summary: Vestas secured a firm order for 52 V236-15.0 MW turbines and a 15-year service agreement for Ecowende at Hollandse Kust West.

events.title: Shinan-Ui names Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Vestas signed a preferred supplier agreement with Hanwha for the 390 MW Shinan-Ui offshore project in South Korea.

events.title: Second Polish offshore manufacturing plant proposed
events.summary: Vestas announced plans for a V236-15.0 MW blade factory in Szczecin, separate from its planned offshore nacelle assembly plant.

events.title: Empire Wind 1 conditional agreement progresses
events.summary: Vestas announced progress on a conditional turbine supply agreement for Equinor’s 810 MW Empire Wind 1 project following New York’s new offshore award.

events.title: Waterfront V236 verification turbine ordered in Denmark
events.summary: Vestas secured an order for a V236-15.0 MW turbine at the Port of Thyborøn to support verification before serial offshore production and installation.

events.title: Nordseecluster A places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas received a firm order for the 660 MW Nordseecluster A phase, covering 44 V236-15.0 MW turbines and service.

events.title: Conditional Nordlicht I and II turbine agreement announced
events.summary: Vestas announced the named scope of its previously disclosed conditional deal with Vattenfall and BASF for 112 V236-15.0 MW turbines across Nordlicht I and II. The deal specified low-emission steel for sections of 56 of the 112 turbine towers.

sources.evidence: Vattenfall and BASF said that low-emission steel would be used in parts of the towers for 56 of the 112 Vestas turbines planned across Nordlicht.

events.title: OranjeWind places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured a 795 MW order for 53 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the OranjeWind offshore wind farm in the Netherlands.

events.title: Zhong Neng turbine installation completed
events.summary: Vestas confirmed completion of offshore turbine installation at the Zhong Neng wind farm in Taiwan.

events.title: First US offshore order confirmed for Empire Wind 1
events.summary: Vestas secured a firm order from Equinor for 54 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the 810 MW Empire Wind 1 project.

events.title: Inch Cape signs conditional turbine order
events.summary: Vestas signed a conditional agreement for 72 V236-15.0 MW turbines at Inch Cape ahead of the December firm order.

events.title: Nordseecluster B secures firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured an order for 60 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the separate 900 MW Nordseecluster B phase.

events.title: Szczecin factory gains port logistics partner
events.summary: Blue Water Shipping and Vestas expanded their agreement to cover port handling and stevedoring for the Szczecin V236 factory.

events.title: Inch Cape places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured an order for 72 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the Inch Cape offshore wind project in Scotland.

events.title: Japanese offshore project orders 21 V236 turbines
events.summary: Vestas received a 315 MW order for 21 V236-15.0 MW turbines at Oga Katagami Akita, its first firm order for the platform in the Asia-Pacific region.

events.title: Fengmiao I places firm turbine order in Taiwan
events.summary: Vestas received a 495 MW order from Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners for 33 V236-15.0 MW turbines and long-term service for Fengmiao I.

events.title: Nordlicht 1 places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas confirmed a firm order from Vattenfall for 68 V236-15.0 MW turbines for Nordlicht 1 in the German North Sea.

events.title: First commercial V236 installed offshore at He Dreiht
events.summary: EnBW reported the first installation at He Dreiht, marking the first commercial offshore installation of the Vestas V236-15.0 MW turbine.

events.title: First EFGL turbine mounted on its floater
events.summary: Ocean Winds reported that the first 10 MW Vestas turbine at EFGL was mounted on its floating foundation at Port-La Nouvelle.

events.title: Vestas secures long-term offshore vessel capacity
events.summary: Cadeler signed a three-year firm contract with Vestas for Wind Keeper to support offshore installation, transport and maintenance, starting in early 2026.

events.title: First EFGL floating turbine installed at sea
events.summary: EDP reported that the first 10 MW Vestas floating turbine at EFGL was towed and anchored at the project site.

events.title: New Jersey terminates Atlantic Shores 1 renewable-credit award
events.summary: New Jersey regulators approved termination of the renewable energy credit award for Atlantic Shores 1, the offshore project that previously named Vestas preferred turbine supplier.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Board of Public Utilities

events.title: Planned Szczecin offshore blade factory paused
events.summary: Vestas confirmed to media that it had paused the separate Szczecin offshore blade plant because of lower-than-expected offshore demand in Europe.

events.title: First Szczecin-built nacelles installed offshore
events.summary: ORLEN reported installation of the first three Baltic Power turbines with nacelles made at the Vestas factory in Szczecin.

events.title: First He Dreiht V236 sends power to grid
events.summary: EnBW reported that the first of its Vestas 15 MW turbines at He Dreiht generated power and exported electricity to the grid.

events.title: Vestas announces 660 MW offshore order in EMEA
events.summary: Vestas disclosed a 660 MW offshore order in EMEA. The announcement did not disclose a project or customer.

events.title: First EolMed Floating Offshore Wind Turbine Heads to Installation Site
events.summary: The first Vestas V164-10.0 MW turbine left Port-La Nouvelle for the EolMed site.

sources.evidence: the first of three Vestas V164-10.0 MW turbines left Port-La Nouvelle for installation at the EolMed floating offshore wind farm.

events.title: Shinan-Ui becomes Vestas’s first firm offshore order in South Korea
events.summary: Vestas secured a firm order for 26 V236-15.0 MW turbines and 20 years of service for the 390 MW Shinan-Ui offshore project.

events.title: Vanguard West places 1.38 GW turbine order
events.summary: Vestas received a firm order from RWE for 92 V236-15.0 MW turbines and service for Vanguard West.

events.title: Kitakyushu-Hibikinada begins commercial operation
events.summary: Hibiki Wind Energy announced commercial operation of the fixed-bottom Kitakyushu-Hibikinada offshore project with 25 Vestas turbines.

events.title: Vanguard East places 1.38 GW turbine order
events.summary: Vestas received a separate firm order from RWE for 92 V236-15.0 MW turbines and service for Vanguard East.

events.title: V236 nacelle and hub plant proposed for Scotland
events.summary: Vestas proposed a Scottish factory for V236 nacelles and hubs, with the investment decision subject to demand and other conditions.

events.title: Qair announces energisation of EolMed
events.summary: Qair reported energisation of the EolMed floating offshore wind pilot, which uses three 10 MW Vestas turbines.

events.title: EFGL floating wind farm delivers first power
events.summary: Ocean Winds reported first grid power from EFGL. Its three 10 MW floating turbines are the Vestas units confirmed in the developer’s earlier assembly announcement and the existing Projects record.

events.title: First Nordseecluster A turbine installed
events.summary: RWE reported installation of the first Vestas 15 MW turbine at Nordseecluster A in the German North Sea.

events.title: EFGL reaches full power
events.summary: Ocean Winds reported full power at the 30 MW EFGL floating wind farm, which uses three Vestas 10 MW turbines.

events.title: He Dreiht completes turbine installation
events.summary: Cadeler completed the offshore installation campaign for all 64 Vestas V236-15.0 MW turbines at He Dreiht.

events.title: Nordseecluster A reaches half-installation milestone
events.summary: RWE reported that 22 of 44 Vestas turbines had been installed at Nordseecluster A and the first turbine had started exporting power in July.

events.title: Culzean floating pilot reaches its offshore site
events.summary: The Culzean Demo Floating Wind Pilot unit carrying a 3 MW Vestas turbine arrived at the North Sea site after tow-out from Wergeland Base in Norway.

events.title: Vestas and Neretek agree to study deeper-water fixed foundations
events.summary: Vestas and Neretek signed a memorandum to explore pairing offshore turbines with Neretek’s bottom-fixed BC90 concept for depths beyond those suited to conventional fixed foundations.

sources.evidence: The Vestas and Neretek MoU concerns a bottom-fixed BC90 concept for transitional deep water, described as an alternative to floating wind.

events.title: Baltic Power completes turbine installation
events.summary: Cadeler completed installation of all 76 Vestas V236-15.0 MW turbines, with full commissioning still pending in the October announcement.

events.title: Ecowende completes turbine installation
events.summary: Van Oord and Vestas completed installation of all 52 offshore turbines at Ecowende, moving the project into testing and commissioning.

events.title: Wando Geumil turbine negotiations delay financing
events.summary: Asia Today reported, citing the project’s Korean power companies, that negotiations with Vestas over construction risk allocation had delayed the financing timetable. The report did not confirm a firm order or cancellation.
